# Awake In A Dream

Artist: Circa Survive

## Lyrics

```text
[Verse]

I hear a voice come from the inside of a lock
And I’m caught up in a game you're in control of

I never remember a thing

I don’t know when I will wake up (I’ll wake up)

Never in my life, never in my life
```
